findings: Velocity check uses position delta, not actual velocity — SafetyMonitor.check_command compares abs(target - current) against velocity limits without dividing by dt. The threshold meaning changes with control rate. (confirmed)
No escalation on repeated safety violations — safe_send_command silently blocks unsafe commands but never triggers e-stop after many consecutive violations. (confirmed)
calibrate_workspace misuses joint_offsets field — stores a 3D translation vector in a field documented as (n_joints,) per-joint offsets. (confirmed)
run_policy_on_robot accesses private robot._sim — couples the generic policy runner to SimulatedRobot internals via isinstance check and private attribute access. (confirmed)
summary: Phase 11 implementation is solid. RobotInterface ABC has all 6 required methods, SimulatedRobot implements them correctly wrapping ForgeSimulation. SafetyMonitor properly validates joint limits, velocity limits, and workspace bounds. Sim2real utilities are well-structured and testable. 56 tests all passing (22 hardware, 18 safety, 16 sim2real). Documentation is complete. Four non-blocking concerns found: velocity estimation uses position delta not true velocity, no e-stop escalation on repeated violations, calibrate_workspace field semantics mismatch, and run_policy_on_robot coupling to SimulatedRobot internals. None are blocking for the current simulated-only use case.
